mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 550K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
